publicFootprint.scope: Exact known-role equality in named public transaction/effect fields; no witness or decrypted-note inspection

publicFootprint.limits: Does not test derived identifiers, linkability across transactions, funding timing, RPC metadata, proof bytes, protocol constants or contract-class contents. rollbackFootprint.scope: Exact known-role equality in named public transaction/effect fields; no witness or decrypted-note inspection
rollbackFootprint.matching: Whole field numeric equality; no substring scan; commitments and delivery matches do not decode identities
rollbackFootprint.limits: Does not test derived identifiers, linkability across transactions, funding timing, RPC metadata, proof bytes, protocol constants or contract-class contents. Private delivery tags/payload are public serialized fields, not decrypted private data. Absence of exact matches is not proof of anonymity.

revertedFinality.scope: one canonical reverted transaction; official local settlement and ordinary L1 mining
